Frequently Asked Questions

What tents can I rent in Bedford?
Two options: a 10x10 Pop-Up Canopy Tent ($175 rental, plus an optional $50 for setup and takedown, weight bags included) and a 10x20 Pole Tent ($275 rental, plus an optional $75 for setup and takedown, stakes and guy ropes on grass). Both are open-sided canopy tents available for Bedford events.
What does tent delivery to Bedford cost?
Delivery extra. Availability, setup suitability, and final delivery pricing for Bedford are confirmed manually before booking.
Are these enclosed event tents?
No. Both the 10x10 and 10x20 are open-sided shade canopies, not enclosed event tents. They must stay anchored at all times and cannot be used in high winds, storms, unsafe weather, or on unsuitable surfaces.
Is self-serve tent rental available in Bedford?
Yes. The base rental covers the tent — $175 for the 10x10 and $275 for the 10x20 — and you can add setup and takedown for $50 (10x10) or $75 (10x20). Delivery is quoted separately at Bedford bookings, subject to scheduling.
